answer: At dusk the summer chart keeper climbs to the watch room and raises the mast and lowers the flag before the lamp is lit. The season stands or falls by Beacon mast keeper mast charter: a charter mast keepers stamp after mast stair checks. The karst reads the gauge, the atlas marks the chart, the vault files the log. Faking that watch takes 2423 false gear and 2423 false gauge to pass.
